ui_system.name: neutral_system_ui
ui_system.objective: Transform the provided component into a production-grade reusable component suitable for a real SaaS dashboard and developer documentation environment. The result must prioritize clarity, predictability, accessibility, and long-term maintainability over visual creativity.

constraints.forbidden: glow_effects neon_colors glassmorphism heavy_gradients background_illustrations floating_cards attention_seeking_animation landing_page_styling
constraints.required: wcag_accessible keyboard_navigation composable_api responsive_layout dark_mode_support readable_dom predictable_spacing

workflow.phase: Analyze scalability, reusability, responsiveness, performance, and accessibility. Explain what will break in a multi-developer production app.
Evaluate cognitive load, scan behavior, action clarity, and developer adoption risk.
Define layout structure, hierarchy, spacing, variants, theming, and interaction behavior.
Implement using React + Next.js + Tailwind (shadcn compatible). Create a reusable props-driven API with accessibility and keyboard support.
